name: Ajkaceratops
sum: Ajkaceratops is a small ceratopsian from the Santonian Csehbánya Formation of Hungary, one of the few from Europe.
wsnote: Estimate in the original description (cited Wikipedia revision).
holotype: MTM V2009.192.1, skull fragments including snout with a rostral bone, premaxillae and maxillae fragments — Csehbánya Formation, Hungary.
material: A more complete skull described in 2026.
biology: Rostral bone fused with the premaxilla.
author: Osi et al. 2010

images.artist: Zoltan Csiki-Sava, Eric Buffetaut, Attila Ősi, Xabier Pereda-Suberbiola, Stephen L. Brusatte
images.caption: Fossil of Ajkaceratops.
